text: I feel curious and attentive in this place. The world tilts around me, as though reality itself asks me to see it from a new angle. The clean lines, glass, and bright signage evoke a sense of innovation—a space dedicated to creation and inquiry. Standing before the 'R+D' wall, I am surrounded by the aura of human intellect in pursuit of progress. I feel a silent invite: to question, to ponder, to participate in the unfolding experiment of knowledge.
